name: Powell's (V3)
author: NUMU
description: Powell's (V3) — a lavender bookshop storefront built for used and rare stock. A filter rail faceted from your own product options, a book page that sells COPIES rather than titles (each variant priced with its own condition and shelf), staff-pick notes signed by a bookseller, and hand-drawn marginalia you can switch off.
description_ar: باول (V3) — متجر كتب بلون بنفسجي متعمل للكتب المستعملة والنادرة. شريط فلاتر بيتبني من اختيارات منتجاتك، وصفحة كتاب بتبيع نسخة مش عنوان (كل متغير بسعره وحالته والفرع اللي فيه)، وملاحظات مكتوبة بإمضاء البائع، ورسومات يدوية تقدر تقفلها.

settings.heading: A million books, and one of them is yours.
settings.body: New, used and rare on the same shelf. Come in for one book, leave with four.

settings.heading: What we're pressing into people's hands
settings.body:
Every book on this page passed through a bookseller's hands before it reached the shelf. We read them, we price them, and we tell you honestly what shape they're in.

Used stock is graded by a person, not a machine — so a cracked spine is described as a cracked spine, and the price reflects it.
